name: roofline

engine.version: none: tools/roofline.cu is a cuBLASLt probe, no engine involved

commands: ssh node-2 'cd lab/nodeops && nvcc -O3 -arch=sm_121 roofline.cu -o roofline -lcublasLt -lcublas'

ssh node-2 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=clocks.sm,clocks.mem,power.draw,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader -lms 500 > clocks.csv & for i in 1 2 3; do flock -x -w 60 /tmp/rexl3-gpu.lock timeout 600 ./roofline; done > roofline.out'
notes: Three back-to-back runs on idle node-2, SM clock locked at 2200 MHz (sampled 2184-2190 MHz under load, clocks.csv). Compared with the HW table of scripts/roofline.py (mean of 3 runs vs table, %): read_gbs 234.0 vs 233.8 (+0.09 %, best run +0.43 %); bf16_tflops_8192 92.6 vs 93.4 (-0.86 %, best run +0.21 %); fp16_tflops_8192 92.8 vs 91.9 (+0.98 %, best run +1.63 %); fp8_tflops_8192 194.8 vs 195.1 (-0.15 %, best run +0.10 %). No difference exceeds 3 %; the table needs no edit. Shape labels are rows x K x N.
